models.name: Two cells and a tissue in one medium
models.notes:
Example of the composition machinery of the comp package: a medium holding two cells and a tissue.

The model definition cell is instantiated three times: twice directly, as the submodels cell1 and cell2, and once through the model definition tissue, which holds a cell of its own. The fourth submodel instantiates an external model definition, a document of unit definitions named with its checksum; the report does not read that document, so what its deletion removes stays a name.

The compartment medium replaces the compartment of every cell, so that the four instances share one volume, and the species glc replaces their glucose. The submodel cell1 loses its own rate constant and its sink reaction through two deletions, and the parameter k_total of this model records that it takes the place of the deleted constant.

listOfCompartments.name: shared medium
listOfCompartments.xml:
<compartment id="medium" name="shared medium" spatialDimensions="3" size="1" units="litre" constant="true">
  <comp:listOfReplacedElements>
    <comp:replacedElement metaid="meta_medium_cell1" comp:portRef="cell_port" comp:submodelRef="cell1"/>
    <comp:replacedElement metaid="meta_medium_cell2" comp:portRef="cell_port" comp:submodelRef="cell2"/>
    <comp:replacedElement metaid="meta_medium_tissue" comp:idRef="cell_in_tissue" comp:submodelRef="tissue1">
      <comp:sBaseRef comp:portRef="cell_port"/>
    </comp:replacedElement>
  </comp:listOfReplacedElements>
</compartment>

listOfSpecies.name: glucose
listOfSpecies.xml:
<species metaid="meta_glc" id="glc" name="glucose" compartment="medium" initialConcentration="5" hasOnlySubstanceUnits="false" boundaryCondition="false" constant="false">
  <comp:listOfReplacedElements>
    <comp:replacedElement metaid="meta_glc_cell1" comp:portRef="glc_port" comp:submodelRef="cell1" comp:conversionFactor="f_amount"/>
    <comp:replacedElement metaid="meta_glc_cell2" comp:portRef="glc_port" comp:submodelRef="cell2"/>
  </comp:listOfReplacedElements>
</species>

listOfParameters.name: rate constant of the medium
listOfParameters.xml:
<parameter id="k_total" name="rate constant of the medium" value="0.1" units="per_min" constant="true">
  <comp:listOfReplacedElements>
    <comp:replacedElement metaid="meta_k_total_cell1" comp:submodelRef="cell1" comp:deletion="del_k"/>
  </comp:listOfReplacedElements>
</parameter>

listOfParameters.name: maximal rate of the medium
listOfParameters.xml:
<parameter id="Vmax_shared" name="maximal rate of the medium" value="1" units="mole_per_min" constant="true">
  <comp:replacedBy metaid="meta_Vmax_shared" comp:portRef="Vmax_port" comp:submodelRef="cell2"/>
</parameter>

models.name: a single cell
models.xml:
<comp:modelDefinition id="cell" name="a single cell" substanceUnits="mole" timeUnits="min" volumeUnits="litre" extentUnits="mole">
  <listOfUnitDefinitions>
    <unitDefinition id="min" name="minute">
      <listOfUnits>
        <unit kind="second" exponent="1" scale="0" multiplier="60"/>
      </listOfUnits>
    </unitDefinition>
    <unitDefinition id="per_min" name="per minute">
      <listOfUnits>
        <unit kind="second" exponent="-1" scale="0" multiplier="60"/>
      </listOfUnits>
    </unitDefinition>
    <unitDefinition id="mole_per_min" name="mole per minute">
      <listOfUnits>
        <unit kind="mole" exponent="1" scale="0" multiplier="1"/>
        <unit kind="second" exponent="-1" scale="0" multiplier="60"/>
      </listOfUnits>
    </unitDefinition>
  </listOfUnitDefinitions>
  <listOfCompartments>
    <compartment id="c" name="cell volume" spatialDimensions="3" size="1" units="litre" constant="true"/>
  </listOfCompartments>
  <listOfSpecies>
    <species metaid="meta_glc_cell" id="glc" name="glucose of the cell" compartment="c" initialConcentration="1" hasOnlySubstanceUnits="false" boundaryCondition="false" constant="false"/>
  </listOfSpecies>
  <listOfParameters>
    <parameter id="k" name="rate constant of the cell" value="0.2" units="per_min" constant="true"/>
    <parameter id="Vmax" name="maximal rate of the cell" value="2" units="mole_per_min" constant="true"/>
  </listOfParameters>
  <listOfReactions>
    <reaction metaid="meta_sink" id="sink" name="consumption of glucose" reversible="false" fast="false">
      <listOfReactants>
        <speciesReference species="glc" stoichiometry="1" constant="true"/>
      </listOfReactants>
      <kineticLaw>
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
          <apply>
            <times/>
            <ci> k </ci>
            <ci> glc </ci>
            <ci> c </ci>
          </apply>
        </math>
      </kineticLaw>
    </reaction>
  </listOfReactions>
  <comp:listOfPorts>
    <comp:port comp:idRef="c" comp:id="cell_port" comp:name="port of the compartment"/>
    <comp:port comp:idRef="glc" comp:id="glc_port" comp:name="port of the glucose"/>
    <comp:port comp:idRef="Vmax" comp:id="Vmax_port" comp:name="port of the maximal rate"/>
  </comp:listOfPorts>
</comp:modelDefinition>
